newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner nine month pretax profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner nine month pretax profit falls.

text.p: NOTE - Year-ago pretax profits included a gain of 219 million on discontinued gas shipping operations and foreign exchange earnings.
The company said turnover increased by 80 percent versus the year-ago period.
NOTE - Kvaerner ASA, the international engineering and construction group, said its operating profit for the nine months fell by 747 million crowns to 912 million.
The results include five months' operations from the former Trafalgar House businesses.
The nine month results also include a profit from the sale of ships of 258 million crowns versus 568 million in the year-ago period and 468 million crowns from other asset sales.
